सं-वाच् f. speaking together, colloquy, RV.

सं-˚वाच्य mfn. to be conversed with &c., MW.
सं-वादाभिजयन n. obtaining the victory in disputes, Hir.

m: सं-वाद m. (ifc. f(आ). ) speaking together, conversation, colloquy with (instr. with and without सह loc., or comp.), RV. &c. &c.
appointment, stipulation, KātyŚr.; Kāv.; VarBṛS.
a cause, lawsuit, ĀpGṛ.; Kathās.
assent, concurrence, agreement, conformity, similarity, W.
information, news, ib.
a: संवादः — 1 Speaking together, conversation, dialogue, colloquy; Mv. 1. 12. --2 Discussion, debate. --3 Communication of tidings. --4 Information, news --5 Assent, concurrence. --6 Speaking likeness, agreement, similarity, correspondence; रूपसंवादाच्च संशयादनया पृष्टः Dk.; (नादः) चित्ताकर्षी परिचित इव श्रोत्रसंवादमेति Māl. 5. 20. --7 Meeting, encounter; U. 5. 16.

m: सं-˚वादक mfn. (fr. Caus.) agreeing, consenting, Sāṃkhyak.
सं-˚वादक m. N. of a man, Hcar.
सं-˚वादन n. (fr. id.) assent, agreement, Kathās.
सं-˚वादिन् mfn. conversing, talking, Ragh.
agreeing or harmonizing with, corresponding to (gen. or comp.), Kāvyād.
a: संवादिन् — a. 1 Speaking, conversing. --2 Like, similar, resembling, corresponding to; षड्जसंवादिनीः केकाः R. 1. 39; अस्मदंगसंवादिन्याकृतिः U. 6.

m: सं-˚वा˚दि-ता f. likeness, resemblance, Harav.
सं-˚वादित mfn. (fr. id.) caused to speak with &c.
agreed upon, MBh.
सं-वादितृ mfn. holding a colloquy, HirP.
सं-˚वाद्य ind. (fr. Caus.) having declared truly or accurately, Mn. viii, 31.

= सं-वाहक, L.

rubbing the body, shampooing, MārkP.
a park for recreation (cf. सं-वास), MBh.; Hariv.
a market-place, Pat., Sch.
extortion oppression, Rājat.
N. of one of the 7 winds (= or w.r. for सं-वह above), L.
सं-वाह &c. See सं-√ वह्.
a: संवाहः — 1 Bearing or carrying along. --2 Pressing together. --3 Shampooing, stroking gently. --4 A servant employed to rub and shampoo the body.

m: सं-˚वाहक mf(इका)n. (fr. Caus.) one who rubs or shampoos the limb
सं-˚वाहक m. a shampooer, R.; Mṛcch. &c.
a: संवाहकः — A shampooer; see संवाह (4) above.

m: सं-˚वाहन n. (fr. id.) bearing, carrying, driving &c., MBh.
the moving along or passage (of clouds), Mālatīm.
rubbing the person, shampooing, Suśr.; Kāv.; Kathās.
a: संवाहनं, --ना — 1 Carrying or bearing a burden. --2 Shampooing; gentle rubbing: U. 1. 24. --3 Bearing along. propelling; Māl. 9. 25.

k.v: विस्तारो विग्रहो व्यासः स च शब्दस्य विस्तरः। संवाहनं मर्दनं स्याद्विनाशः स्याददर्शनम्.।

m: सं-˚वाहिन् mfn. leading, conducting
सं-˚वाहिनी (इनी), f. a partic. vessel of the body (leading from the fetus to the mother), Car.
सं-˚वाहितव्य mfn. (fr. id.) to be rubbed or stroked, MBh.
सं-˚वाह्य mfn. to be borne or carried &c., Pañcat.
to be rubbed or kneaded, W.
to be shown or betrayed (अस्˚), Kpr.
सं-˚वाप m. throwing together, mixing, mingling, ĀpŚr., Sch.

m: सं-वार , ˚रण &c. See p. 1116, col. 1.
सं-वार m. (ifc. f(आ). ) covering, concealing, closing up, MW.
compression or contraction of the throat or of the vocal chords (in pronunciation), obtuse articulation (opp. to the वि-वार, q.v., and regarded as one of the Bāhya-prayatnas), Pāṇ. i, 1, 9, Sch.
an obstacle, impediment, Mṛcch. vii, (v.l.) 6/7
a: संवारः — 1 Covering, closing up --2 Contraction of the throat &c. in the pronunciation of letters, obtuse articulation (opp. विवार q. v.). --3 Diminution. --4 Protecting, securing. --5 Arranging.

m: सं-˚वारण mfn. (ifc.) warding off, keeping back, MBh.
सं-˚वारयिष्णु mfn. (fr. Caus.) intending to ward off, MBh. vi, 3762 (B.)
सं-˚वार्य mfn. to be covered or concealed (see संवृत्त-स्˚)
to be kept back or warded off (see अ-स्˚).

s: puM, (saMvasantyatreti । saM + vas + GaY .) gfham । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, bfhatsaMhitAyAm । 95 । 13 । “Bayado janasaMvAsAt yadi BARqAnyapanayet kAkaH ॥”) puravAsinAM vihArArTaM puramaDye bahirvvA anAvftasTAnam । tatparyyAyaH । sanniveSaH 2 sannikarzaRam 3 । iti jawADaraH ॥ (yaTA, rAmAyaRe । 2 । 49 । 4 । “SfRvan vAco manuzyARAM grAmasa vAsavAsinAm । rAjAnaM Dik daSaraTaM kAmasya vaSamAsTitam ॥” ekatrAvasTAnam । yaTA, manuH । 8 । 273 । “brAtyayA saha saMvAse cARqAlyA tAvadeva tu ॥”

m: सं-वास m. dwelling together, living or associating with (instr. with and without सह, or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
cohabitation, sexual connexion with (comp.), Car.
a common abode, Kām.
a settlement, dwelling, house, MBh.; R. &c.
an open place for meeting or recreation, L.
association, company, society, W.
a: संवासः — 1 Dwelling together. --2 Association, company; Pt. 1. 250. --3 Domestic intercourse. --4 A house, dwelling. --5 An open space for meeting or recreation.

m: 1. सं-वासिन् mfn. (ifc.) clothed in MBh.
2. सं-वासिन् mfn. dwelling together, a fellow-dweller, Kām.; Rājat.
(ifc.) dwelling in, inhabiting, MBh.; R.
सं-वासित mfn. (√ वास्) made fragrant, perfumed, MW.
made fetid, having an offensive smell (said of the breath), Suśr.
a: संवासित — a. 1 Made fragrant, scented, perfumed. --2 Made fetid, having an offensive or foul smell (as a breath).

m: सं-वावदूक mfn. agreeing, consenting, Anarghar.
संवाटिका f. the aquatic plant Trapa Bispinosa, L.
सं-√ वीज् Caus. -वीजयति, to fan, BhP.; to cause (the hair of the body) to stand erect, Car.
सं-वीक्ष् (वि-√ ईक्ष्) Ā. -वीषते to look about, look at attentively, see, perceive, R.; Pañcat.

search, inquiry, L.
a: संवीक्षणं — 1 Looking about in all directions, search, looking for anything lost. --2 Looking or gazing attentively.

covered or surrounded or furnished with, concealed or obscured by (instr. or comp.), ib.
hidden, invisible, disappeared, Hariv.
wrapped round, Bālar.

सं-वीत n. clothing, Śāntiś.
a: संवीत — p. p. 1 Clothed, dressed. --2 Covered over, coated, overlaid. --3 Adorned. --4 Invested, surrounded, shut in, hemmed. --5 Overwhelmed.

m: सं-वीत—राग mfn. one whose passions have disappeared, Hariv.
सं-˚वीतिन् mfn. girt with the sacred thread, Siṃhās.
सं-वंह्. See सम्-√ बंह्.
सं-√ वञ्च् P. -वञ्चति, to totter, stagger, waver, TS.

सं-√ वद् P. Ā. -वदति, ˚ते (ind.p. सम्-उद्य, q.v.), (Ā.) to speak together or at the same time, AitBr.; ChUp.; (P.; Ā. only mc.) to converse with (instr.) or about (loc.), RV.; AV.; TS.; Br.; (P.) to sound together or in concord (said of musical instruments), AV., to agree, accord, consent, Hariv.; Mṛcch.; Kathās.; to coincide, fit together (so as to give one sense), Ratnāv.; to speak, speak to, address (acc.), BhP.; to designate, call, name (two acc.), Śrutab. : Caus. -वादयति, ˚ते (ind.p. -वाद्य, q.v.), to cause to converse with (instr.) or about (loc.), ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; to invite or call upon to speak, Hit., (v.l.); to cause to sound, play (a musical instrument), MBh.; Kathās.
a: संवद् — {c1c} P. 1 To talk to, address. --2 To speak together, converse, discourse. --3 To resemble, tally with, correspond to, be like (with instr.); अस्य मुखं सीताया मुख वंद्रेण संवदत्येव U. 4; अदो संवदंत्यक्षराणि Mu. 5. --4 To name, call. --5 To agree, accord, consent. --Caus. 1 To consult, hold consultation (with instr.); as in मौहूर्तिकैः सह संवाद्यतां. --2 To cause to sound, play upon (a musical instrument). --3 To declare.

m: सं-वदन n. the act of speaking together, conversation, Śaṃk.
a message, L.
consideration, examination, L.
(also, f(आ). ) subduing by charms or by magic (= or w.r. for सं-वनन, q.v.), L.
a charm, amulet, W.
a: संवदनं — 1 Conversing, talking together. --2 Communication of tidings. --3 Examination, consideration. --4 Subduing or overpowering by magic or charms. --5 A charm, an amulet.

m: सं-˚वदितव्य mfn. to be talked over or agreed upon, ŚBr.
to be spoken to or addressed.

(3. du. pf. सं-ववाहतुः, iii, 11005 accord. to some fr. सं-√ वाह्); to manifest, express, BhP. : Pass. -समुह्यते, to be borne by (instr.), ride on (instr.), MBh.; BhP. : Caus. -वाहयति, ˚ते (Pass. -वाह्यते), to cause to be brought together, bring together, assemble, Hariv.; Rājat.; to guide, conduct, drive (a carriage), MBh.; R.; Kathās.; to chase, hunt, Pañcat. v, 14; to rub, stroke, Āpast.; R.; Śak. &c.; to set in motion, Kād.; to take (a wife), marry, Vet. (v.l.)
a: संवह् — {c1c} P. 1 To carry or bear along, drag. --2 To carry together. --3 To rub, press. --4 To show, display. --Caus. 1 To rub or press together, shampoo; संवाहयामि चरणावुत पद्मताम्रौ Ś. 3. 21. --2 To assemble, collect. --3 To drive (a carriage). --4 To marry, take a wife. --5 To carry away, drive along, impel; Pt. 5. 15.

N. of one of the 7 tongues of fire, Col.
a: संवहः — N. of the third of the seven courses or Mārgas of the wind: see वायु.

m: सं-˚वहन n. guiding, conducting, Suśr.
showing, displaying, Kuval.

mixture, union, Mālatīm.; Gīt.
a: संवलनं — 1 Combination, junction, union. --2 Being mixed or charged with; Māl. 9. 13, 10. 11.

सं-वल्गन n. jumping (with joy), exulting, Anarghar.
सं-˚वल्गित mfn. overrun, MW.
a: संवल्गित — a. Overrun. --तं A sound; Māl. 5. 19.

broken, diversified (= चूर्णित), Kir., vi, 4, Sch.

सं-वनिन् mfn. concordant, Hir.
सं-√ 2. वप् cl. 1. P. Ā. -वपति, ˚ते, to throw together, mix, pour in VS.; TS.; ŚrS.; to scatter, sow, MW.

। samayasyAnapAkama tadvivAdapadaM smftamiti” । pAzaRqAH vEdikamArgadveziRaH kzapaRakAdayaH । nEgamAH sArTikA vaRija iti madanaratne । nEgamAH zedaprAmARyAByu pagantAraH pASupatAdaya iti mitAkzarAyAm । AdiSabdena vidvadbrahmaRasamUhAdInAM grahaRam । samayasyAnapAkarma vyatikramaH saMmayAparipAlanamiti yAvat tadvyatikramyamARaM vivAdapadamBavatItyarTaH । tadrUpayogyArTamAha vfhasyatiH “vedavidyAvidA viprAH tezAM vftti॰ prakalpayet” iti । yAjYavalkyo'pi “rAjA kftvA pure sTAnaM brahmaRyaM nyasya tatra tu । trEvidyaM vfttimad brUyAt svaGarmaH pAlyatAmiti” । brahmaRAnAM samUho brahmaRyam । “brAhmaRamAnavavAqavAdyaditi” pA॰ sUtreRa yat । vidyA vedA tisfRAM vidyAnAM samAhArastrividyam । trividyamaDIte iti । tezAM vfttiM prakalyayedityasyA'rTo vfhaspatinEva vivftaH “anAcCedyakarAsteByaH pradadyAd gfhaBUmikAH । yuktaBAvyaSca nfpatirleKayitvA svASAsanam” iti । anAcCedyakarAH agrAhyakarAH । etaduktamBavati । AgAminfpatiBiragrAhyakarAH teByo sisfzwakarASca gfhaBUmikAH pradadyAditi । evaM niyuktEryatkartavyaM tadAha yAjYavalkyaH “nijaDarmAviroDena yastu sAmayiko Bavet । so'pi yatnena sarakzyo Darmo rAjakftaSca yaH” iti । nijaDarmAviroDena SrOtasmArttakarmAviroDena sAmayikaH samayAnnizpanno yo Darmo gopracArodakarakzaRadevagfhapAlanAdirUpaH so'pi yatnena rakzaRIyaH । yaSca rAjYA kfto nijaDarmAviroDenEva yaH sAmayiko Darmo yAvatpaTikamBojanandeyamasmadarAtimaRqale turagAdayo na prasTApanIyA ityevaMrUpaH so'pi yatnena rakzaRIya ityarTaH । vfhaspatirapi “nityaM nEmi ttikaM kAmyaM SAntikampOzwikantaTA । pOrARAM karma kuryyuste sandigDe nirRarya taTeti” । pOrARAM puravAsinAmityarTaH । evaM rAjaniyuktasamudAyaviSezasya kAryyaviSeza uktaH । sarvasamudAyAtAYca kAryyamAha sa eva “grAsaSreRigaRAnAYca saNketaH samayakriyA । bADAkAle tu sA kArTyA DarmakAryye taTEva ca । cAwacoraBaye vADAH sarvasADAraRAH smftAH । tatropaSamanaM kAryyaM sarveScEkena kenaciditi” । gaRAnAYcetyatra caSabdaH pAzaRqanEgamAdInAM samuccayArTaH । tataSaca gaRapAzaRqanEgamAdInAM lamayakaraRamantareRa yadyupadravo duHpariharaH DarmakAryyaM ca duHsADyantadA pAriBAzikI samayakriyA sarvormalitEH kAryyA । cAwovfkaH । cAwacorAdiByo Baye prApte tadupaSamanaM sarvEH kArvyamityarTaH । DarmakAryyamapi samBUya kAryyamityuktaM tenEva “maBAprapAdevagfhatawAkArAmasaM skatiH । taTA'nATadaridrARAM saMskAro yajanakrivA । kulAyananiroDaSna kAryyamasmABiraMSataH । yatrEtalliKitaM patre DarmyA sA samayakriyA । pAlanIyAH samastEstEryaH samarTo visaMvadet । sarvasvaharaRaM daRqastasya nirvAsanaM yurAditi” । samA maRqapaH । prapA pAnIyaSAlikA । ArAsaH upavanama । saMskatiH jIrRodDAraH । saMskAra upanayanAdikaH predadahamAdikaSca । yajanakriyA somayAgAdikarttfByo dAnama । kulAyananiroDaH । kulAyanasya durBikzAdyapagamaparyantasya DAraRam । kulyAyanaviroDaSceti kalpatarO pAWaH । kulyAyananiroDaH kulyAyAH pravarttanamapratisanDaSca । evaM kftA samuyakriyA na kevalaM sayudAyiBireva pAlanIyA api tu rAjYApi ityAha nAradaH “pAzaRqanEganaSreRipUgavrAtagaRAdizu । saMrakzet samayaM rAjA zwurgaM janapade taTeti” । pAzaRqA । vedoktaliNgaDAraRavyatiriktAH sarve liNgimaH । tezu vihitaBikzAcaraRAdyAH santi । nEgamAH sArTikA vaRikpraBftayaH । tezu sakaYcukasandeSaharapuruzatiraskAriRo daRqyA ityevamAdayobahavaH samayA vidyante । aTa vA nEgamAH AptapraRetftvena ye vedaprAmARyamicCAnta pASupatAdayaH । SreRayaH ekaSilpopajIvinaH । tAsvidaBanayEva SreRyA vikreyamityevamAdikAH samayA varIvarttante । pUgA hastyaSvArohAdayaH । vrAtagaRaSabdayArarTamAha kAtyAyanaH “nAnAyuDaDarA vrAtAH samavetAstu kIrttitAH । kulAnAM hi samUhastu gaRaH samparikIrttitaH” iti । pUge vrAte vAstramutsfjya samare na gantavyamityevamAdayaH samayA varttante । gaRe tu paYcame dine paYcame varze vA karRaveDaH karttavya ityevamAdi samayaH samasti । gaRAdItyatrAdiSabdena brahmapurInivizwasya mahAjanAdeH parigrahaH । tatra gurudakziRAdyarTamAgatA mAnanIya ityAdiH samayo'sti । durge tu DAnyAdikaM gfhItvA anyatra na tadvikreyamityAdirasti samayaH । janapade tu kvacidvikretfsakASAcCulkagrahaRamityAdyanekaviDaH samayo varovarttate । tadevaM samayajAtaM yaTA na BraSyati taTA rAjA kuryyAdityarTaH । samUhAdipuruzavizaye viSezamAha vfhaspatiH “koSena leKyakriyayA maDyasTErvA parasparam । viSvAsaM kftvA yaH kuryyuH kAryyARi samanantaram” iti । koSena devatAsnAnodakapAnena । leKyakriyayA samayapatreRa । maDyasTEH pratiBUBiH kAryyARi samUhatAryyARi । etadaktaM Bavati । samudAyiBiH parasparaM samayAtikramABAvAya koSAdiBirviSvAsamutpAdya sAmayikakAryyARi karttavyAnIti । kAtyAyano'pi “samUhAnAM tu yo Darmastena DarmeRa te sadA । prakuryuH sarvakarmARi svaDarmezu vyavasTitAH” iti । sAmayikaDarmanijaDarmAnatikrameRa sarvakAryyARi samudAyinaH kuryurityaryaH । yAjYavalkyo'zi “nijaDarmAviroDena yastu sAmayiko Bavet । so'pi yatnena saMrakzyI Darmo rAjakftaSca yaH” iti । nijaGarmAviroDenetyanena nijaDarmAviroDI sAmayiko DarmA yaTA sanvyAvandanavelAyAM sarvEreva svavyApAraprarihAreRa, rAjaBavanaM pratyAgantavyaM yo nAyAsyati praTamasAhasaM daRqyaH iti nAsO rakzya ityarTAduktam । kAtyAyano'pi “avaroDena Darmasya nirjitaM rAjaSAsanam । tasyEvAcaraRaM pUrvaM sarttavyantu nfpAjYayeti” । Darmasya SrOtasmArttAdi Darmasya nirjitaM kftamityarTaH “rAjYA pravarttitAn DarmAn yo naro nAnupAlayet । garhyaH sa pApo daRqyaSca lopa yan rAjaSAsanam” iti । vicitrabudDiBiH samudA yiBiranekErEkamatyena kAryyakaraRAsamBavAt dvitrAH paYca vA kAryyacintakAH karttavyA ityAha vfhaspatiH “dvO trayaH paYca vA kAryyAH samUhAhatavAdinaH । karttavyaM vacanantezAM grAmaSreRigaRAdiBiriti” । kAryyacintakezu heyopAdeyAndarSayati sa eva “vidveziRo vyasaninaH SAlInAlasaBIravaH । lubDAtivfdDabAlASca na kAryyAH kAryyacintakAH । Sucayo vedaDarmajYAH dakzA dAntAH kulodBavAH । sarvakAryyapravIRASca karttavyAYca mahAttamAH” iti । SAlInAH aDfzwAH kAryyacintakAH sa mudAyakAryyasADakavicArakAH । kAryyAcintakAnAmapi samUhahitavAdinAM vacanaM sarvEH samUhiBiH kAryyAmityAha yAjYavalkyaH “karttavyaM vacanaM sarvEH samUhahitavAdinAm” iti । samUhapratikUlasya praTamasAhasaM daRqa ityAha sa eva “yastatra viparItaH syAt sa dApyaH praTamaM damam” iti । praTamaM pUrvasAhasam । kAtyAyano'pi “yuktiyuktaM vaco hanyAd vakturyo'navakASataH । ayuktaYcava yo vrUyAt sa dApyaH pUrvasAhasam” iti । vfhaspatirapi “yastu sADAraRaM hiMsyAt kzipettrEvidyameva vA । sanDikriyAM vihanTAcca sa nirvAsyastataH purAt” iti । sADAraRam samudAyagrAhyaM daRqAdi dravyam । hiMsyAt । daRqyAdeH sAhAyyakaraRAnnASayet kzipet vA tirazkuryyAdityarTaH । samUhinAmapyaDarmeRa dvezAdinA kAryyakaraRe daRqamAha sa eva “bADAM kuryurya ekasya samBUtA dvezasaMyutAH । rAjYA tu vinivAryAste SAsyA ScEvAnuvanDataH” iti । anubanDataH nigrahatAratamyAnu sAreRa । muKyAnAmnaparAkzaviSeze daRqaviSezamAha yAjYavalkyaH “gaRadravyaM haredyasvu sa vidaM laNGavecca yaH । sarvasvaharaRaM kftvA taM rAzwrAdvipravAsayet” iti । muKya daRqane samUhasyEvADikAraH । ataeva kAtyAdDanaH “sAhasI BedakArI ca gaRadravyavinASakaH । ucCedyAH sarva evEte viKyApyEva nfpe Bfguriti” । nfpe viKyApya gaRenocCedyA ityaryaH । samUhASaktO tasya daRqo rAjYA viDayaH । ataeva mamuH “yo grAmadeSamaNGananAM kftvA satyena saMvidam । visaMvadennaro loBAttaM rAzwrAdvipravAdDayet । nigfhya dApayeccEgaM samayazyaBivAriRam । catuHsuvarRAn zaRRizkASCatamAnaYca rAjatam । evaM daRqaviDiM kuryyAdDArmikaH pfTivIpatiH । grAmajAtisamUhezu samayavyaBicAriRAm” iti । etezAM pravAsanacatuH suvarRazaRRizkaSatamAnarUpARAYcaturRAM daRqAnAYcAti vidyAguRAdyapekzayA vyavasTA kalpanIyA । yattu kaYcidetezAYcaturRAM daRqAnAM krameRa brAhmaRAdicaturvarRavizayatvamityAha tadajYAnavilasitam । etAdfSavyavasTAyAM pramARABAvAt । brAhmaRasya pravAsana kzatriyAdInAYcatuHsuvarRAdi daRqa ityasyAnucitatvAcca । marmodGAwakAdInAM purAnnirvAsanameva daRqa ityAha vfhaspatiH “aruntudaH sUcakaSca BedakftsAhasI taTA । SreRipUganfpadvizwaH kzipraM nirvAsyate tataH” iti । aruntudaH marmodGAwakaH । sUcakaH piSunaH । piSunO KalasUcakAvityaBiDAnAt । Bedakft samudAyizu vEmatyakft । samUhasTAnAnnirvAsyate samUheneti SezaH । na ca samUhasya daRqakaraRe'naDikArAt samUheneti SezakaraRamayuktamiti vaktavyam । pUrvoktakAtyAyanavacanena samuhasyEva muKyadaRqane'DikArasya pratipAditatvAt “pUgaSreRigaRADyakzAH puradurganivAsinaH । vAgDigdaRqaparityAgaM prakuryuH pApakAriRam । tEH kftaM yat saDarmeRa nigrahAnugrahaM nfRAm । tadrAjYa manumantavyaM nisfzwArTA hi te smftAH” iti vfhaspatinAmaBiDAnAcca । vAgdaRqaH pApizWo'sItyAdi BAzaRam । DigdaRqoDiktvAmiti BAzaRam । parityAgo'sadvyavahAryyatva karaRaM nirvAsanaM vA । uBayatrApi loke parityAgaSabdaprayogadarSanAt । etaccArTadaRqAderupalakzaRArTam । nigrahAnugrahamityetena punaH sAmyenABiDAnAt nisfzwArTA ajYAtakAryAH । nArado'pi “pfTaggaRAMstu ye Bindyuste vineyA viSezataH । AvaheyurBayaM GoraM vyADivattehyupekzitA” iti । gaRAn SreRyAdirUpAn । vfhaspatirapi “tatra BedamupekzAM vA yaH kaScitkurute naraH । catuHGavarRaM zaRizkAMstaKa daRqo viDIyate” iti । muvarRacatuzwayazaRRizkayoH SaktyAditAratanyAnunAreRa guRavadaguRavadvizayatvena vA vyavasvA mantavyA । pAzaRqAdisavasamUhezu rAjYA yaTA varttitavyantadAha nAradaH “yo DarmaH karma yaccEzAmupavyAwaviDiSca yaH । yaccEzAM pratyupAdAnamaBumatyet tattaTeti” । DarmaH satyavadanAdiH । karma prAtaHprarDu zitamikzAdanAdiH upasyanabiDiH zamUhakArTArTaM mfdaNgAdiDvanimAkarRyaM maRqapAdO mesanam । pratTupAdAnaYjIvanAya tApasavezaparigrahaH । ezAM pAzaRqinAmityarTaH । anyadapi rAjakftya mAha sa eva “pratikUlaru yadrAjYaH prakftyA ca mataYca yat । bADakaYca yadarTAnAM tattembo'pi nivarttayet” iti । yadrAjYaH pratikUlam “yaTA yasya rAjYarstu kurute SUdroDarma vivecagam । tasya prakzuByate rAdraM balaM koSaSca naSyati” iti । evaYca sArTikAdiSUdravivAde GarmavivecanaM ca yadrAjYa ityasyodAharaRammantavyam । prakftyA svaBAvata eva matam avajYAtArTaM pAzaRqAdizu tAmbUlaBakzaRAdikam । yaccArTAnAM vADakanDananASakacOrAdisaMbADAdikaM tatteByo'pi nivarttayet । yaTA te na kurvanti taTA kurvyAdityarTaH । anyadapi nivarttyamAha sa eva “dozaMvatkaraRaM yatsyAdanABrAyaprakalpitam । pravfttamapi tadrAjA SreyaskAmo nivarttayet” । lomAdidozavatkaraRa SrutismftivirudDaM viDavAdO veSyAtvAdikaM pAzaRqAdiBiH prakalpitam । tadbahukAlapravfttamapi rAjYA nivarttanIyamityarTaH । trEvidyAnAM pratipAditaM DarmaM SreRyAdizvatidiSati yAjYavalkyaH “SroRinEgamapAzaRqigaRAnImapyayaM viDiH । BedaYcEzAM nfporakzet pUrvavfttiM ca pAlayet” iti । samUhakAryArTamAgatAya yadrAjYA samUha pUjArTaM dattantadyadi samUhAyAsO na dadAti tadA taddattaM ekAdaSaguRaM dApya ityAha sa eva “samUhakAryya AyAtAn kftakAryAn visarjayet । sadAnamAnasatkArEH pUjayitvA mahIpatiH । samUhakAryyaM prahitA yallaBeta tadarpayet । ekAdaSaguRaM dApyo yadyasO nArpayet svayam” । iti । yallaBeta samUhasamBAnanArTamiti SezaH । yato rAjadattaM sarvasADArARamato yaTAMSato viBAgaM kftvA grAhyaM nisvAdiByo vA dAtavyamityAha vfhaspatiH “tato laByeta yatkiYcit sarvezAmeva tatsamam । zaRmAsikaM mAsikaM vA viBaktavyaM yaTAMSataH । deyaM vA niHspavfdDAnGastrIyAlA turarogizu । sAntAnikAdizu taTA Darma eva satAtanaH” iti । ekasya puruzasya zaRmAsanirvAhAya paryyAptaM kuwumbasya vEkasya zaRmAsanirvAhAya paryyAptaM, labDaM vA yaTAMSataH svasvAMSAnurUpeRa viBajanIyannisvAdiByo vA deyamiti tAtparyArTaH rAjaprasAdalabDavadfRamapi sarvezAM samamitpAha sa eva “yattEH prAptaM rapitaM vA gaRArTaM vA vA fRaM kftam । rAjaprasAdalabDaYca sarvezAmeva tatsamam” iti । ayamarTaH । tEH samUhakAryyArTaM prahitEryatsImAvivAdAvaDiM kzetrArAmAdikaM DarmADikaraRe tyAyataH pAptam । yacca parErapahriyamARaM rakzitaM yacca lamUhaprayojanArTamupAttamfRam, yacca rAjaprasAdalabDaM tat sarvaM sarvezAM samudAyinAM samamiti । gaRakftamfRaM sarvezAM samamityasya kvacidapavAdamAha kAtyAyanaH “gaRamuddiSya yatkiYcit kftvarRaM BakzitaM Bavet । AtmArTaM viniyuktaM vA dEyaM tEreva tadBavet” iti । tEH muKyEH । ye tu samudAyAnugrahAttadantarBAvaM prAptAH ye ca samudAyakzoBAdinA tato bahirBUtAstAn pratyAha sa eva “gaRAnAM SreRivargARAM gatAH syuryye'pi maDyatAm । prAkftasya GanarRasya samASAH sarva eveti । taTEva BojyavEBavyadAnaDarmakriyAsu ca । samUhasTo'MSaBAgI syAt prAggatastvaMSaBANnatviti” ।
